# Eden Grove

> Eden Grove is a luxury real estate team at Compass, representing new
> construction and estate homes across Nashville, Brentwood, Franklin and the
> wider Middle Tennessee market.

Founded by Ryan Stonehouse and Blake Barker. Based at 2206 21st Avenue South,
Nashville, Tennessee 37212. Telephone (615) 812-0066.
Email clients@edengrovetennessee.com. Instagram @edengrovetn.

## What the team does
- Representation of luxury and new-construction homes across Middle Tennessee
- Compass Private Exclusives — properties marketed off the open market
- Cinematic film, architectural photography and drone work for every listing
- A dedicated property website for each home, updated as a build progresses
- Buyer representation and private showings across Nashville and Williamson County

## Areas covered
Belle Meade, West Meade, Green Hills, Forest Hills, Oak Hill, Brentwood,
Franklin, Leiper's Fork, Arrington, Thompson's Station, Downtown Nashville,
Germantown.
